newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble stable,demand constant on 1996 book-closing.
newsitem.headline: Rouble stable,demand constant on 1996 book-closing.

text.p: The rouble fluctuated within tiny limits in lively trading on Monday, with banks closing arbitrage positions, but dealers said rouble demand generally persisted on the market on 1996 balance-squaring.
roubles/dollar Dec 23 midday Dec 23 early Dec 20 close
"Dollar rates first eased than edged up back to opening levels. It all looked like squaring of short positions after the weekend," one dealer said.
Dealers believed trading activity would be falling in the last few days of 1996 but rouble demand was likely to be constant on closing of this year's books.
"But the dollar fall is likely to be smooth as non-residents are now getting back their dollar profits from (Russia's) government bonds issued in summer," another dealer said.
He added the rouble could enter 1997 at the level of 5,560 per dollar.
